overview.objective: Stop checkout from crashing on an empty cart.
overview.context: internal/cart handles cart state; internal/checkout reads it at payment time.

problem.text: checkout panics when cart.Items is nil instead of an empty slice.

loop.text: fails: nil pointer dereference in checkout.Total

problem.repro: create a cart, call Checkout without adding items

hypotheses.prediction: initializing Items to []Item{} makes the loop pass

goals: checkout never panics on an empty cart

demo.text: an empty cart checks out for zero dollars instead of crashing

design.shape: NewCart initializes Items to an empty slice; checkout reads it unchanged.

changes.before: Items field left at its zero value (nil)

files.reason: initialize Items to an empty slice

tests.name: TestEmptyCart_ReturnsEmptyOrder
tests.asserts: checkout of a freshly created cart returns a zero-item order, no panic

tasks.text: Initialize cart.Items to an empty slice in NewCart.

alternatives: guard checkout.Total with a nil check instead of fixing the source
risks: other constructors that build a Cart by struct literal still skip this initializer
